_note: One row per gate, written by hand; tooling/gate-inventory.py reads it with tooling/required-steps.json and tooling/gate-mutations.json and writes tacenta-proofs/GATE-INVENTORY.md. A control is a path, or an object with ci_steps (the CI steps that run it, for a control the script walk cannot see), ci:false (it does not run in CI) or indirect:true (it does not name the gate in its text).
